items.rationale: Variance is actual minus plan, so 495 - 540 = -45. The negative sign shows the store is behind plan.
C2-B2 is 150 and ABS keeps 150. For a store 150K behind plan, ABS would also give 150, which is why it measures size only.
ABS(D2) turns a shortfall into a positive size, so one comparison catches both directions. D2>B8 misses stores far below plan. ABS(D2)<B8 is the opposite test. ABS cannot be wrapped around text.
50 > 50 is FALSE because > means strictly more than. The false branch returns OK. Use >= if the limit itself should be flagged.
